metadata.description: Self-hosting marketplace for the keycutter skill: clone the `skill` branch of github.com/mbailey/keycutter, then `claude plugin marketplace add ./keycutter-skill`.

plugins.name: keycutter
plugins.description: Touch-gated SSH keys (YubiKey, or a Mac's Secure Enclave with Touch ID) and a sane multi-account ~/.ssh/keycutter/ config tree — a security-auditable subset for fresh-machine, hardware-backed SSH.
